text:
## Decision: SHIP

Ship the **treatment** arm. The primary metric's CI excludes zero on the good side, the bounce guardrail passed, SRM passed, and there are no planned interim looks. Only one treatment arm, so the plan's Holm adjustment is not triggered.

## Primary result

Plan context: 2 arms (control n=14,911, treatment n=15,089), primary metric **conversion** (MDE 10% relative, alpha 0.05), guardrail **bounce**, planned n 30,000 [r1].

- conversion: treatment vs control **+13.3% (95% CI +6.07% to +21.1%), p = 0.00021; absolute +0.01315 (0.09885 -> 0.112); better** [r3].

## Guardrails

- bounce: treatment vs control **-0.101% (95% CI -3.49% to +3.41%), p = 0.95; guardrail passed (no statistically significant harm)** [r4].

## Validity checks (SRM, peeking, novelty)

- SRM: **observed split control 49.7% / treatment 50.3%; chi2 = 1.056, p = 0.3; SRM check passed** [r2].
- Peeking/interim: no planned interim looks [r1], so sequential testing is not required.
- Novelty: **conversion by day (treatment vs control): day 1 +48.8%, day 14 +6.57%; trend -3.29 percentage points of lift per day, p = 0.011: the effect shrinks over time (novelty pattern)** [r5].

## Caveats

- The daily effect shows a statistically significant decay/novelty pattern, so the overall lift may overstate the longer-run benefit [r5]. This does not override the pre-registered ship rule.
- Only one guardrail was pre-registered; other potential harm metrics are not covered.

## Exploratory findings

- platform segment (exploratory, not part of the decision): no evidence the effect differs by platform (Cochran's Q p = 0.52). android **+8.23% (-3.41% to +21.3%), p = 0.17 adjusted**; ios **+14.9% (+4.24% to +26.7%), p = 0.015 adjusted**; web **+18.6% (+2.33% to +37.7%), p = 0.047 adjusted** [r6].
